text:
morgan: Heads-up from AM: AegisMed opened a dispute on INV-2026-77777. They say the platform fee and reseller discount weren't applied correctly during a staged migration to Dedicated. Need quick alignment before renewal next month.
sylvia: drop invoice lines and any contract refs?
morgan: invoice extract pasted: 
```
INV-2026-77777
Period: 2026-10-01 to 2027-09-30
Private Deployment Platform Fee (annual) - $80,000
Support: Standard (annual) - $8,500
Reseller discount: 10% on platform fee (applied at inception for first year) - not reflected on this invoice?
Staged migration: 40% capacity moved to Dedicated 2026-11-15 to 2027-02-14 (OPS-9988)
Committed GPU true-up - 410 hrs @ $14/hr = $5,740
```
morgan: customer says reseller agreed a 10% platform discount and that during the staged migration we should have applied pro-rata discount for the period moved off Private; they attached a reseller agreement PDF and ops ticket.
raj: contract check: reseller discount clause exists in reseller addendum (SA-R-2026-03) but discount was meant to apply to net platform charges. need to see billing system entry.
sylvia: OPS confirms OPS-9988 moved 40% capacity for 91 days starting 2026-11-15. Ops didn't request billing action. reseller agreement attached by customer shows email sign-off from partner on 2026-10-05. sales logs show discount flag but invoice line indeed lacks the 10% deduction.
morgan: customer requests two items: (1) apply reseller 10% discount to platform fee for full year and then pro-rate the migration reduction (i.e., additional credit for the 40% moved off Private for 91 days), (2) exclude 95 hours of GPU true-up that ops marked as "test-drive" in OPS-9988.
sylvia: finance take: we should apply the reseller 10% credit for the platform fee immediately if documented in SFDC/opportunity. pro-rate migration credit only if sales/partner explicitly authorized a migration concession. GPU test hours verification with ops needed.
raj: numbers: platform 10% = $8,000 immediate credit if accepted. migration pro-rate (if approved) = 80,000 * 0.4 * 91/365 = $7,978.08. GPU exclude 95 hrs -> credit = 95 * $14 = $1,330.
morgan: customer wants account-level credit now to avoid payment dispute. They asked for revised invoice before renewal.
sylvia: proposed steps: 1) post reseller discount credit memo for $8,000 (reference INV-2026-77777) now, 2) create provisional migration credit memo for $7,978.08 marked "pending partner/sales sign-off", 3) create GPU adjustment CM for $1,330 pending ops verification, 4) place invoice on a 30-day hold.
billing-bot: automated: provisional credit memo CM-2026-1200 created for $8,000. Reference INV-2026-77777. Status: pending approval.
raj: I'll validate SFDC entries and partner email. If paperwork confirms partner authorization, migrate credit can be approved.
legal: i'll need the reseller agreement excerpt and any partner written sign-off before finalizing the platform concession. verbal partner commitment insufficient.
morgan: ops attached OPS-9988 with 95 hrs labeled test-drive; will upload logs.
billing-bot: automated: provisional credit memo CM-2026-1201 created for GPU adjustment $1,330. Reference INV-2026-77777. Status: pending ops verification.
collections: customer requested hold until 2026-12-20. can collections allow 30 days for strategic renewal?
collections: yes we can place a 30-day hold for strategic accounts. we'll mark the invoice on hold and notify AR team.
sylvia: action items: (1) revenue-ops approve CM-2026-1200 (@raj), (2) legal confirm reseller docs for platform concession (@legal), (3) ops verify test hours and attach logs for CM-2026-1201 (@morgan -> ops), (4) collections set 30-day hold until 2026-12-20 (@collections).
raj: i'll escalate to partner ops for written confirmation of the migration concession. if partner signs off, we'll approve CM-2026-1202 for $7,978.08.
morgan: customer wants written confirmation by EOD 2026-11-25. we should aim for that.
legal: if reseller agreement and partner email are present in SFDC, i can approve the reseller credit immediately as a documented contractual adjustment. migration credit needs partner authorization or Head of Revenue sign-off.
sylvia: i'll message the AE and partner ops now. thanks everyone, i'll update customer thread once CM-2026-1200 posts and the hold is in place. :white_check_mark:
